_: The AI engines this stage declares. A and B are the two of C4b and C5b, the ones the pipeline was measured on; C, D and E were added after the finale and are not measured. One file, read by config/llm/engines.py, so the interface can offer a choice of engine without a code change (submission checklist item 9) and the run manifest can record which one produced a row. Selecting an engine sets a default per role; an explicitly set model variable still wins, which is how the A/B harnesses pin two models of one provider.
_1_1: Added 2026-10-04, all additive. (1) `models`: the models of each engine a role may be given, each with a price card. (2) Engines C, D and E, reached over the OpenAI-compatible chat API by config/llm/openai_compat_client.py. (3) A role may be given its own engine with RDTII_ENGINE_MAPPER, RDTII_ENGINE_VERIFIER or RDTII_ENGINE_ESCALATION; unset, the role follows RDTII_ENGINE. A and B, their role models and the request Claude receives are unchanged. `measured: false` marks an engine or a model the pipeline has NOT been run and scored on: the prompts, the traps and every reported figure were made on engine A.
_price: price = US dollars per million tokens: [input, output, cached input read, cache write]. Read from each provider’s own price page on 2026-10-04. Where a provider has no separate cache-write charge the input price stands in. A model with no card is metered at $0 and the interface says so before a run.
_default: The engine used when RDTII_ENGINE is unset is NOT this one: with no RDTII_ENGINE the stage keeps its pre-engine behaviour and reads LLM_PROVIDER and the four model variables directly. `default` is what an interface should preselect.
_roles: triage is always local (kickoff decision #3: a local model never maps, verifies or breaks a tie, and the cheap screen is local-first), so both engines name the same triage model and the factory forces its provider.

B.label: Qwen2.5 14B Instruct, open weights, local
B.name: Qwen
B._models: Any other model pulled on the local Ollama server can be chosen from the interface; it is metered at $0 and is not measured.
B._digest: Read from the local Ollama server on 2026-09-27 (ollama 0.34.4). The tag qwen2.5:14b can be repointed upstream; the digest cannot, so this is what a reviewer should verify with `ollama list --digests`.
B._context: The model's own limit. What the client actually requests is OLLAMA_NUM_CTX (16384): Ollama defaults to 2048 and truncates from the FRONT, which silently drops the indicator definition.
B.workers_note: One worker: a single 14B model on one GPU has no concurrency to gain, and the dense embedding leg competes for the same device.
B.notes: Reproduced Round 1's Sonnet verdict on the canonical trap case through the real S4 path on 2026-09-26 (6.1 false, 6.4 applies, score 1, Horizontal, every quote grounded) in 27 s at $0.
